source.title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/2024 of 26 July 2024 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2020/1056 by establishing the eFTI common data set and eFTI data subsets (OJ L, 20.12.2024)

elements.name: eFTI data set content

elements.name: eFTI data set consignment
elements.definition: The consignment is a separately identifiable collection of consignment Items (available to be) transported from only one consignor to only one consignee via one or more modes of transport. A consignment can be at a master level which covers a consolidated cargo (could be a single house level consignment or more than one) contracted between freight forwarder as the consignor and a carrier, or at house level which covers the cargo contracted to be moved by the freight forwarder on behalf of the buyer or the seller. In addition in case of road, it can also be at a subcontract level which covers the case of a road carrier (aka haulier) contracted to move the goods on behalf of another road carrier.

elements.name: Consignor party
elements.definition: The consignor (aka sender of the goods) is the party defined, in the contract of carriage as the party sending the consignment (goods) to be delivered whether by land, sea or air. The consignor could be the enterprise which consigns goods either on its own behalf or for a third party.

elements.definition: The consignee (aka receiver of the goods) is the party defined, in the contract of carriage, as the party receiving the consignment (goods) sent by the consignor to be delivered whether by land, sea or air. If the transport operation takes place without a contract of carriage, the entreprise which takes charge of the goods on arrival shall be deemed to be the consignee.

elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Name
elements.definition: The name of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Registration country
elements.definition: The country of registration of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Registration country code
elements.definition: The country code of the registration country of the transport means used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Owner
elements.definition: The party that owns the transport means used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Name
elements.definition: The name of the owner of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Dimensions
elements.definition: The spatial dimensions of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Description
elements.definition: The description of the dimensions of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Width
elements.definition: The width of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Length
elements.definition: The length of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Height
elements.definition: The height of the means of transport used in the main leg of transportation of the consignment of goods from one place to another.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Operational equipment
elements.definition: Operational equipment attached to this means of transport, such as refrigerator unit or ropes etc.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the operational equipment attached to this means of transport.

elements.name: Category code
elements.definition: The code specifying a category of operational equipment attached to this means of transport.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Unit quantity
elements.definition: The number of pieces of operational equipment attached to this means of transport.

elements.name: Itinerary route
elements.definition: The route in the itinerary of this main transport movement.

elements.name: Description
elements.definition: The description of the route in the itinerary of this main transport movement.

elements.name: Call event
elements.definition: The call event is a stop during transportation (e.g. ship, plane) at a location (e.g. maritime port, airport) included on an itinerary for arrival, stay in and departure from it.

elements.name: Call location
elements.definition: The location of this call during the main carriage transport movement.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the location of this call event during the main carriage transport movement.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Border crossing event
elements.definition: A border crossing event during this main transport movement.

elements.name: Actual occurrence date
elements.definition: The actual date/time of the border crossing event.

elements.name: Date time format code
elements.definition: The code of the format of the date/time content.

elements.name: Occurrence location
elements.definition: The logistics location where this border crossing event occurs during the main transport movement.

elements.name: Name
elements.definition: The name of the logistics location where this border crossing event occurs during the main transport movement.

elements.name: Pre-carriage transport movement
elements.definition: The pre-carriage is any transport movement that takes place prior to the cargo being delivered to the port/terminal where the main leg of transportation used for the carriage of the consignment of goods from one place to another will take place.

elements.name: Mode code
elements.definition: The code specifying the mode, such as by air, sea, rail, road or inland waterway, for this pre-carriage transport movement.

elements.name: Arrival event
elements.definition: The arrival event of the means of transport used for the pre- carriage transport movement.

elements.name: Scheduled occurrence date
elements.definition: The scheduled arrival date/time transport means used for the pre-carriage transport event.

elements.name: Date time format code
elements.definition: The code of the format of the date/time content.

elements.name: On-carriage transport movement
elements.definition: The on-carriage is any transport movement that takes place after the cargo being delivered at the port/terminal where the main leg of transportation used for the carriage of the consignment of goods from one place to another has taken place.

elements.name: Mode code
elements.definition: The code specifying the mode, such as by air, sea, rail, road or inland waterway, for this on-carriage transport movement.

elements.name: On-carriage unloading event
elements.definition: The unloading event for this on-carriage transport movement.

elements.name: Unloading location
elements.definition: The location where the unloading event occurs for this on-carriage transport movement.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the location of the unloading event for this on-carriage transport movement, such as a United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE).

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Name
elements.definition: The name of the location of the unloading event for this on-carriage transport movement.

elements.name: Specified transport movement
elements.definition: Specified transport movement and its events in the context of a consignment.

elements.name: Logistics event
elements.definition: A logistics event related to the specified transport movement.

elements.name: Type code
elements.definition: The code specifying the type of logistics event related to this specified transport movement.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Event location
elements.definition: The location of the logistics event related to this specified transport movement.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the location of the logistics event related to this specified transport movement such as a United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE).

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Name
elements.definition: The name of the location of the logistics event related to this specified transport movement.

elements.name: Transport service
elements.definition: The transport service for this supply chain consignment such as combined transport.

elements.name: Description
elements.definition: The description of the transport service for this supply chain consignment

elements.name: Condition type code
elements.definition: The code specifying a type of contractual condition for this transport service, such as a transport contract condition.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Applicable service charge
elements.definition: A logistic service charge applicable to this supply chain consignment, such as freight or insurance charges.

elements.name: Charge type
elements.definition: The code of the type of this logistics service charge.

elements.name: Payment arrangement code
elements.definition: The code specifying the payment arrangement for this logistics service charge.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Applied amount
elements.definition: The monetary value applied for this logistics service charge.

elements.name: Amount currency code
elements.definition: The code of the currency of the amount.

elements.name: Paying party role code
elements.definition: The code specifying the role of the party responsible for paying this logistics service charge.
elements.allowed: AB, AE, AF, AH, A, AR, AT, AU, CA, CG, CN, CX, CZ, DGB , EX, FW, GS, IM, IV, PE

elements.name: Calculation basis code
elements.definition: The code specifying the basis on which this logistics service charge is calculated, such as by volume or per unit.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Calculation basis price
elements.definition: The price upon which a calculation of this logistics service charge is or will be based.

elements.name: Basis quantity
elements.definition: The quantity on which the applicable charge is based.

elements.name: Quantity unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Unit amount
elements.definition: The unit price basis for the monetary value of the applicable service charge.

elements.name: Amount currency code
elements.definition: The code of the currency of the amount.

elements.name: Category type code
elements.definition: The charge category code, such as refund or service charge, for this price basis calculation.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Consignment transport package
elements.definition: The transport packages, such as a box or a barrel, within which the goods of this consignment are contained for logistics purposes.

elements.name: Package quantity
elements.definition: The quantity of the logistics packages at this level.

elements.name: Type code
elements.definition: The code specifying the type of the consignment transport package.

elements.name: Type text
elements.definition: The name of the type of the consignment transport package.

elements.name: Information
elements.definition: Information related to the consignment transport package.

elements.name: Shipping marks
elements.definition: The shipping marks and barcodes for the consignment transport package.

elements.name: Marking text
elements.definition: The marking, expressed as text, on the consignment transport package.

elements.name: Associated party
elements.definition: A trade party associated with this consignment.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the associated consignment party.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Cargo nature identification
elements.definition: Cargo details for the consignment that are sufficient to identify its nature for customs, statistical or transport purposes.

elements.name: Nature of goods code
elements.definition: The code that specifies the nature of the consignment cargo.

elements.name: Goods description
elements.definition: The description of the nature of the consignment cargo.

elements.name: Operational category code
elements.definition: The category code, such as obnoxious or hazardous, that specifies the operational nature of the consignment cargo.

elements.name: Statistical classification code
elements.definition: The classification code that specifies the nature of the consignment cargo for statistical purposes.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Regulatory procedure
elements.definition: A regulatory procedure applicable to this consignment.

elements.name: Type code
elements.definition: The code specifying the type of the cross-border regulatory procedure for this consignment.

elements.name: Customs import office location
elements.definition: The location of the specified customs office which is responsible for import formalities for the goods which are subject to this cross-border regulatory procedure for the consignment.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the customs import office.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Customs export office location
elements.definition: The location of the specified customs office which is responsible for export formalities for the goods which are subject to this cross-border regulatory procedure for the consignment.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the customs export office.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Customs transit office location
elements.definition: The location of the specified customs office which is responsible for transit formalities for the goods which are subject to this cross-border regulatory procedure for the consignment.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the customs transit office.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Dangerous goods
elements.definition: Dangerous goods details applicable to the transport of the consignment.

elements.name: Information
elements.definition: General information concerning the transport of the dangerous goods of this consignment.

elements.name: Explosive cargo net mass
elements.definition: The total net mass, in kg, of explosive contents for all dangerous substances and articles in this consignment.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Radioactive material
elements.definition: The radioactive material (Class 7) of the transported dangerous goods in this consignment.

elements.name: Applicable radioactive isotope
elements.definition: The maximum activity of the radioactive contents capable of sustaining a nuclear fission chain reaction during carriage, expressed in (multiples of) becquerel relating to the radioactive material in the consignment.

elements.name: Activity level measure
elements.definition: The measure of the radioactive contents during carriage, expressed in (multiples of) becquerel.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Condition statement
elements.definition: Statement containing additional information about the conditions of the dangerous goods consignment.

elements.name: Subject type code
elements.definition: A code specifying the subject of the statement regarding the condition of the dangerous goods in this cargo consignment.

elements.name: Value measure
elements.definition: The measure of a value for this specified condition of the dangerous goods loaded in this cargo consignment.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: Statement code
elements.definition: The code of the statement regarding the condition of the dangerous goods in this cargo consignment.

elements.name: Statement text
elements.definition: The statement to be provided, in accordance with the dangerous goods regulations, regarding the condition of the dangerous goods in this cargo consignment.

elements.name: Related document
elements.definition: A document related to the dangerous goods in this cargo consignment..

elements.name: Type code
elements.definition: The code specifying a type of dangerous goods transport related document for this consignment.

elements.name: Attached binary object
elements.definition: A binary object that is attached or otherwise appended to the document related to the dangerous goods in this consignment.

elements.name: Regulatory exemption
elements.definition: An exemption from a regulatory requirement related to the dangerous goods in this consignment.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of an exemption from a dangerous goods regulatory requirement for this consignment.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.

elements.name: Type code
elements.definition: A type code specifying a regulatory exemption from a dangerous goods regulatory requirement for this consignment.

elements.name: Code list agency code
elements.definition: The code of an agency that maintains one or more code lists.

elements.name: Reportable exemption calculation
elements.definition: A calculation to be reported to support this exemption from a dangerous goods regulatory requirement for this consignment.

elements.name: Reportable quantity
elements.definition: The reportable quantity used for calculating an exemption from a dangerous goods regulatory requirement for this consignment.

elements.name: Hazard category code
elements.definition: The code specifying the hazard category to be used for the exemption calculation from a dangerous goods regulatory requirement for this consignment.

elements.name: Consignor provided border clearance instructions
elements.definition: Border clearance instructions provided by the consignor for this consignment.

elements.name: Instructions
elements.definition: The description of these provided border clearance instructions.

elements.name: Logistics risk analysis result
elements.definition: The results of a logistics risk analysis calculation for this consignment.

elements.name: Consignment risk related code
elements.definition: A code specifying a consignment related risk for this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: Description
elements.definition: The description of this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: Risk level code
elements.definition: The code specifying the level of risk for this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: Screening method code
elements.definition: A code specifying a method of screening used for this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: Security exemption code
elements.definition: A code specifying a security exemption for this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: General information
elements.definition: General information relating to this logistics risk analysis result.

elements.name: Notified waste material
elements.definition: Waste material notified for this consignment.

elements.name: Weight
elements.definition: A measure of the weight of the waste material notified for this consignment.

elements.name: Measurement unit code
elements.definition: A code specifying a unit of measure.

elements.name: ID
elements.definition: The identifier of the waste material notified for the consignment.

elements.name: Identification scheme agency code
elements.definition: The code of the agency that maintains the identification scheme.
